Module descriptors

The module descriptors for our undergraduate courses can be found below.

Year 1 (Core)

  • AERO40001: Aerodynamics 1
  • AERO40006: Mathematics 1
  • AERO40008: Structures 1

Year 2 (Core)

  • AERO50001: Aerodynamics 2
  • AERO50009: Propulsion and Turbomachinery
  • AERO50010: Engineering Practice 2: Project Development

Year 3 (Optional)

  • AERO70003: Advanced Propulsion S1
  • AERO70037: Spacecraft Propulsion S5
  • AERO70042: Quantification of Aerospace Environmental Impact S4
